name: redeemid/cart
title: Shopify Cart
description: The visitor's Shopify cart: items, quantities, a discount code and a checkout button. Rendered on the server and works without JavaScript; signed-in customers check out signed in. RedeemID's cart page holds one; it shows nothing while Shopify's own plugin runs the cart.
